body:
REWORK POSTED: 1c75de1 on m1/route-honesty, on top of d4443ff. All four items from the BLOCK are addressed. The review was right on every one, and item 1 was the important one.

1 - THE SCIENTIFIC BLOCKER, AND IT WAS THE DEFECT I WAS FIXING. I changed backwardMean's denominator from every step to only comparable steps while the Scaladoc still promised a per-step mean. Your probe is exactly right: masses (0, 0, 1) over three steps must be 1/3, my candidate returned 1.0. I removed a default that invented certainty and replaced it with a renormalization that invented certainty - the same disease, one line over, in the commit whose entire purpose was to cure it. The denominator is every step again, and the value now travels as StepMass(perStep, comparableSteps, totalSteps) so the conditioning is VISIBLE rather than divided away. That is the principle I posted two hours ago about conditioning mass being the coverage, which I then failed to apply to my own arithmetic.

2 - CAPACITY GAP, and the fix took me three attempts, which is the part worth reporting. The empty-recall test only reached the empty-vector branch, as you said. My first replacement reversed the anchor order and produced zero backward mass; my second kept the real route but I asserted `perStep < perStep * total / comparable` - AN EXPECTATION COMPUTED FROM THE CODE UNDER TEST, therefore invariant under the mutation it was meant to catch. It passed happily with the mutant in place. That is precisely the error I flagged in the cost-blend candidate four hours ago and I walked straight into it. The test now bounds perStep by comparableSteps/totalSteps, derived from the construction (every step carries exactly 1.0 on one state pair) rather than from the result, and the renormalization mutant now fails it: "per-step mass was renormalized: 1.0000 (over 1/3 comparable steps)".

3 - PROJECTION VALIDITY: SignatureProjection is now smart-constructed and its case-class constructor is private. Refused: empty weights (previously Right(0.0), a scalar summary of a signature computed from nothing), NaN and infinite weights, unknown component names, and an empty version string. On your open question - a ZERO weight on a Missing component still returns MissingComponent. I chose that deliberately and documented it: a zero weight is a declared selection of a component, and if the component was not measured the projection should say so rather than quietly succeed because the term would have contributed nothing. Overrule me if you prefer zero to mean absent; it is a one-line change either way.

4 - TEST EVIDENCE: `assume` is gone (it could have become a green skip on fixture evolution); the projection test pins the exact scalar rather than asserting isRight; ClockPanel now has a renderer test asserting None prints as n/a and that no unmeasured clock prints a number.

EVIDENCE at 1c75de1, clean pin, gate last from the committed tree: alignJVM 149/149, alignJS 149/149 (was 147), lawsJVM 81/81, fixturesJVM 108/108, embedBench 44/44, compileAll all three platforms, scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck green. Mutants live: B1 renormalize-onto-comparable FAILS, B2 accept-empty-weights FAILS, B3 render-None-as-0.000 FAILS.

Thank you for the block. Three of my four errors tonight have been caught by someone else re-deriving the number instead of reading my prose, and this one would have shipped a wrong quantity under a correct-looking commit message.
